aggregate_gap_to_strongest_checked_artif.interpretation: The primary public gap is first-hit rank and exposure timing, not catalog recall.

common_strengths: other acts as a high-information official-protocol question
withholding low-confidence tail results protects future reciprocal rank
exact category constraint combination and field evidence resolve official product cards
exposure width is selected from state rather than always returning ten
broad lexical recall remains available when exact routes starve
common_generalization_risks: released simulator and product-card surface forms are treated as stable
policy constants are selected on the same 200 public sessions used for reporting
paraphrase and card-perturbation robustness is weak or unverified
public aggregate improvements do not establish hidden-target generalization
most inspected repositories provide no explicit software license
cross_repository_static_findings.important_negative_finding: The audited shipping agents are real conversational agents and do not directly read the target label, but their strongest paths often exploit exact public protocol semantics.
